hist_case.problem: Build V2 Evidence Fusion: combine transcript/timing/tonality/history/face-body signals into calibrated confidence, with real weight learning from outcomes
hist_case.case_text: Second of five Communication System versions (founder-locked build order 2026-08-06/07). Prototype already proven 30/30 in scripts/prototype-evidence-fusion-v2.mjs; this mission ports it into a live, callable shared-infrastructure service that V3/V4/V5 depend on.
hist_case.opportunity: Replaces N different ad hoc single-modality heuristics with one shared, calibrated, learnable confidence engine -- no new algorithm risk, reuses already-proven scoring.
